Package dev.px.core.math

Class Vec2

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.math.Vec2
public final class Vec2 extends Object
An immutable 2D double vector.

Used for screen coordinates and for yaw/pitch pairs. Core defines its own rather than borrowing the game's so nothing in the maths layer needs a version-specific type.
